name: Aldren Scaleside Swim Short
description: A mid-thigh short in quick-dry ripstop with an interior lining that uses a smooth slick-weave to prevent abrasion against scale geneware. The waistband is reinforced but soft-edged, and the leg openings have a subtle flare to accommodate scale ridges at the thigh. Comes in a cool slate blue with minimal branding. Works as casualwear as well as near water.
functionality: Slick interior lining prevents chafing against scale geneware; quick-dry for aquatic or high-sweat environments
what_it_says: Functional, low-key, and bought from someone who thought about what scales actually feel against fabric.
worn_by: people near the Lake District recreational zones
story_hooks: The Lake District access pass sewn into the waistband pocket belongs to someone reported missing three weeks ago.
A street vendor sells near-identical shorts with a sandpaper lining — returning customers are a problem they haven't solved yet.

physical_description.visual_profile: Sleek mid-thigh shorts with a subtle athletic edge and aquatic sensibility. The cut is modern and understated, designed for both water and urban wear. Silhouette reads as confident and body-aware without being tight.
physical_description.fit: Tailored through the hip with a slight taper, flaring gently at the leg openings to accommodate scale ridges and movement. Waistband sits naturally at the hips with a soft, reinforced edge that doesn't dig into skin or geneware.
physical_description.primary_material: Quick-dry ripstop synthetic weave exterior with interior slick-weave lining—engineered to prevent friction against scale geneware and other subcutaneous modifications.
physical_description.texture: Ripstop exterior has a subtle dimpled texture for durability and water shedding; interior lining is smooth and frictionless to the touch, almost liquid-feeling.
physical_description.color_scheme: Cool slate blue—a neutral urban tone that reads expensive without ostentation. Minimal visible branding, suggesting understated tier-2 confidence.
physical_description.closures: Reinforced magnetic snap at the waistband with a concealed drawstring mechanism for secure adjustment without bulk.
distinctive_features: Flared leg openings designed for scale-geneware accommodation
Soft-edged waistband engineered for comfort against modified bodies
Minimal branding—just small Aldren heat-stamp at back waistband
Subtle abrasion-prevention stitching reinforcement at seams
Quick-dry technology visible in fabric sheen and water-beading properties
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2—premium functional wear. The engineering and material quality signal disposable income, but the understated styling avoids corpo ostentation.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by modded aquatic enthusiasts, bioaugmentation enthusiasts, and lake-district corpo workers who need reliable gear that accommodates their geneware. Also appeals to fitness-conscious middle-management types who want performance wear that doesn't scream 'gym rat.'
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to broken-in. The ripstop and slick-weave resist pilling and wear, maintaining a clean appearance even after heavy use. Salt-water or pool chlorine may cause subtle discoloration over time, adding character.
